fields.title: Welcome to ProgressRPG
fields.body: ProgressRPG turns real-life effort into character progress. Use the tutorial arrows to see the core loop, then press Done when you are ready to play.

fields.title: Watch Your Character Grow
fields.body: As you log activity, your character earns XP and levels up. Keep returning to build a streak of steady progress.

fields.title: Start a Focus Session
fields.body: Choose what you want to work on, start the timer, and stay with it. Completed focus time becomes activity that can earn XP.

fields.title: Review Recent Activity
fields.body: Your completed sessions appear in recent activity. Use them to check what you have done and keep your progress honest.
